# UnifyOne — 1Commerce Solutions

> UnifyOne is a multi-tenant e-commerce and gig-economy SaaS platform built for independent operators, small businesses, and digital entrepreneurs. It unifies sales channels, income streams, and operations into one dashboard.

## What UnifyOne Does

UnifyOne solves the fragmentation problem for modern sellers: instead of juggling separate tools for Shopify, PayPal, Square, Stripe, and gig-platform income, everything flows into a single tenant-scoped workspace.

Core capabilities:
- **Multi-channel commerce** — sell and sync inventory across Shopify, Square, and custom storefronts from one product catalog
- **Unified payments** — accept and reconcile payments via Stripe, PayPal, and Square with a single ledger
- **Gig-income tracking** — consolidate earnings from delivery, rideshare, and freelance platforms; auto-estimate quarterly taxes and deductions
- **Subscription billing** — tiered plans (Acolyte → Architect → Cathedral) with per-seat and credit-metered usage
- **AI automation** — Claude-powered workflows for product descriptions, customer responses, and data insights
- **Team collaboration** — role-based access, multi-user tenants, affiliate and referral management
- **Analytics** — revenue by day, top products, funnel conversion, and platform-level MAU tracking

## Who It's For

- Side-hustlers and gig workers managing multiple income sources (Uber, DoorDash, Etsy, eBay, etc.)
- Small e-commerce operators who sell on more than one platform
- Micro-SaaS and digital-product sellers who need subscription billing + analytics without enterprise overhead
- Independent contractors who need estimated-tax tooling for 1099 income

## Free Tools

UnifyOne offers standalone free calculators at `/tools/`:
- Gig mileage + deduction estimator
- Multi-platform earnings consolidator (true hourly after expenses)
- Quarterly estimated-tax estimator for 1099/self-employed income
- Reseller break-even and pricing calculator
- Payout-timing / cash-flow tracker for multi-gig income

These tools work without an account. Results can be saved to a dashboard by signing up.

## Technology

- React 19 + TypeScript frontend, deployed on Netlify
- Express + tRPC backend, Node 22
- PostgreSQL (Neon) primary database via Drizzle ORM
- Supabase for credit metering and Stripe object storage
- Anthropic Claude SDK for AI features
